ir_source_qualification.note: Fresh IR binary executed on this batch. Its original phase source identity is retained; IR and front-end patch/new-file inputs are identical in the final snapshot. Focused IR cases overlap the full scope.

superseded_tooling_commands.label: metadata-control
superseded_tooling_commands.reason: Diagnostic passed the compact public source identity to the existing native validator; that validator also requires shared_configuration from the actual host identity. One baseline consumer completed; no candidate comparison was summarized. Production/qualification/RSC/situations/PMU/size inputs unchanged. Corrected validator argument and reran all72 control processes.

coverage.limits: No full workspace CI or pinned Test262 rerun. Focused scopes may overlap broader scopes and must not be summed. All Engine scopes ran on identical current product inputs with preserved source qualification; four preexisting AOT library failures remain failures.
coverage.source_guards_qualification: All 361 source-only guards pass on the frozen candidate.

baseline.preservation: Hash-verified prior source reconstruction in the prior published archive; old histories are not nested.

caveats: Same exact module bytes and seed schedule; each actor includes its public call bridge and print conversion/capture. Empty control is shown without subtraction.
Preparation, source/native compilation, module initialization and result validation are outside call timing. Preparation can still affect later natural GC, feedback and JIT invalidation.
Three warmups and seven samples describe this schedule; V8 is allowed normal JIT/GC and is not claimed to have reached optimized steady state.
Operations count logical source work, not retired lookups or allocations; optimizations and folding are allowed.
Shallow/deep also vary padding captures/arithmetic. Deep/bound-deep is the closer resolution contrast; bound aliases may fold. Getter row includes live getter calls and counter increments.
Branch cases vary control-flow, static/dynamic step keys and call-site polymorphism. Native image growth is measured; individual stack frame sizes and probe cost are not isolated.
Observed arguments adds arguments property reads; differences are not allocations. Property mutation occurs in preparation; no compact/dictionary representation is asserted.
Native serialized P image includes metadata and data; portable Wasm P is separate. Child peak RSS includes host, code and process history, not just guest heap.
Scriptc has no compatible retained-module prepare/run ABI in this workflow, so its fresh WASI entry is not substituted.
These focused programs complement the separate RSC and fresh-entry kernel cohorts; no aggregate workload score or current-source requalification of those cohorts is implied.
implementation: One typed private GetOwnProperty helper returns whole Completion plus nullable GC descriptor; only public reflection creates JavaScript descriptor objects.
Ordinary/Array direct snapshots, recursive Proxy validation, exotic storage dispatch and explicit execution Realms retain their existing ownership.
Matched ordinary records, JavaScript functions and native constructors expose name/length read costs beside the existing situations.
Runtime layout 51 rejects older cache entries and build packages before reuse.

metadata_control.limits: Balanced two-block control; eight fresh processes per actor/case, three warmups and seven measured calls; same prepared source and checksums; cold native preparation and input preparation excluded. Separate from latest Fast/Speed/V8 chart cohort. No allocation count or pure descriptor-cost attribution.

source_receipt.kind: ordinary compact shape birth-site mechanism control
source_receipt.limits: Only prepare birth sites differ; no product or scored-campaign generator/source changes. This control does not itself prove cache hit counts or runtime allocation counts.

summary.limits: Unscored mechanism control on the current compiler. Eight distinct objects and identical timed run text/checksums; preparation differs. Timing alone does not isolate shape identity or allocation. Encoded run comparison is retained separately. This control is not merged into the16-program latest chart cohort.

encoded_run_inspection.scope: Unscored mechanism control; actual retained Fast P from completed 48-process campaign; no production changes
encoded_run_inspection.validation: Both retained P modules pass wasmparser 0.245.1 Validator with all Wasm features; artifact SHA256 matches producer receipt
encoded_run_inspection.difference_interpretation: All four constants address the captured declarative BindingCell table: seed slot 3 to 4 and rows slot 1 to 2, shifted by the added module factory declaration. Raw bodies have no other differing bytes.

runtime_name_resolution.source: Actual R exports plus actual R function name section

source_mechanism: crates/scriptw-aot-wasm/src/objects/compact_data/shape.rs: literal shapes are lazy per source site and physical ProgramInstance
crates/scriptw-aot-wasm/src/objects/property_read_plan.rs: P compares current storage shape and static key against a monomorphic metadata cache before loading this receiver value
crates/scriptw-aot-wasm/src/objects/compact_data/cache.rs: a shape miss probes keys and overwrites the cached shape and slot
encoded_run_inspection.inference: The same emitted timed read paths operate over different prepared shape identities. The timing direction is consistent with repeated monomorphic shape misses for eight literal sites and reuse for a single factory site.
limits: Static call sites are not measured dynamic call counts or cache miss counters.
The control changes preparation and module/native layout; native body equivalence and GC-state equivalence were not measured.
This control does not quantify RSC benefit or explain the remaining Scriptw versus V8 gap.
The three cached-read call sites include fallback paths; they are not a claim that every read executes its runtime helper.
encoded_run_inspection.next_experiment: Intern equal ordered static key/attribute layouts at compile time into the existing ProgramInstance CompactShape table. Keep original eight-literal source unchanged, values/prototypes per object, existing current-storage guards and generic fallback; compare original mechanism control plus mutation correctness and RSC before any general claim.
